text: RESOLVED: gaze binning is entity-primary. Construal[C,E,R] is a validated many-to-many entity/role relation, and role traces are pure projections of an immutable EntityTrace; alternative construals never rerun gaze assignment. TraceSource determines the quantity/result type: sample time and clipped fixation dwell carry non-negative durations, fixation onsets carry non-negative counts. Temporal Overlap selects events while EventAllocation independently determines clipped-intersection versus whole-at-onset contribution. Spatial membership is policy-indexed: exclusive/priority outputs satisfy a partition identity; multiple-membership outputs use visible-union accounting and report pairwise overlap plus mass by multiplicity. Epoch anchors are serializable selectors with explicit occurrence and final-bin policies. Rationale: role-first bins defeat construal independence, one Span payload cannot represent counts, and one accounting identity is false under multiple AOI membership.
